source_rule: Decisions must be based on the matched full-text PDF. Existing coding labels are out of scope.

integration_tiers.CORE: Ontology or semantic constraints operate inside a complete retrieval-to-generation, verification, or governance loop.
integration_tiers.WEAKER: A GraphRAG or KG-RAG loop is present, but ontology is limited to a lightweight schema, vocabulary, or background semantic context.
integration_tiers.ANCHORED: Ontology or KG evidence guides an LLM generation, reasoning, verification, or agent workflow without a complete retrieval-generation loop.
integration_tiers.CONSTRUCTION: Ontology or KG construction, extraction, enrichment, alignment, evolution, or enabling infrastructure is the primary contribution before downstream RAG.
integration_tiers.INTERFACE: The primary contribution is natural-language graph access, formal-query generation, or KG question answering without a complete ontology-aware RAG loop.

roles.T1: Semantic Schema: ontology or schema controls representation, class/relation typing, entity alignment, graph construction, mapping, or validation.
roles.T2: Retrieval Prior: ontology or schema constrains query generation, semantic search, graph traversal, subgraph selection, query expansion, SPARQL/Cypher generation, or retrieved context.
roles.T3: Reasoning Backbone: executable rules, logic, proof procedures, reasoners, planning preconditions, or explicit inference materially contribute to the result.
roles.T4: Governance Layer: ontology or KG evidence supports operational verification, provenance checking, conflict/compliance handling, rejection, correction, or abstention.

cross_role_rules: Generic RAG, vector search, or graph use does not establish T2 without semantic control.
A generated rationale or an unexecuted graph path does not establish T3.
A trustworthiness claim without an operational control action does not establish T4.
Constraint use only during KG construction is T1 unless it also controls an answer, claim, decision, or operational workflow.

evidence_levels.described: The mechanism is stated or architecturally proposed, without sufficient evidence that it was executed.
evidence_levels.implemented: The mechanism was instantiated or executed in a system, algorithm, query, reasoner, validation, or workflow, but was not directly evaluated as a mechanism.
evidence_levels.evaluated: The role-specific mechanism was tested, measured, validated, benchmarked, or ablated. Overall end-to-end evaluation alone is insufficient.
evidence_levels.not_evidenced: Used only for a decision of 0; no qualifying operational evidence was located.

locator_rule: Every positive role and every integration tier requires an exact excerpt, one-based PDF page, available printed page label, section locator, and source PDF hash.

reviewer.independence_statement: This pass codes from source PDFs and structured extraction records independently without prior integration-tier or role assignments.
